name: Zener diode
description: A zener diode (1N47xx, 1 W) conducts forward like a normal diode, and backwards once the voltage reaches its zener voltage, which it then holds nearly constant. Connect the cathode (K, black band) to the higher voltage through a resistor and the anode (A) to GND: the cathode stays at the zener voltage, a simple voltage regulator or reference.
